interface.name: ukui_background_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface allows clients to create background buffer.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: destroy the ukui background manager object

request.description: Destroy the manager object. The existing background objects will be unaffected.

entry.name: background_exists
entry.summary: the output already has a background objects with the same type

entry.name: wallpaper
entry.description: The background type wallpaper describes the background object buffer is from wallpaper picture.

entry.name: screenlock
entry.description: The background type screenlock describes the background object buffer is from screenlock picture.

request.name: create_background
request.description: Creates a new background object associated with the given output. If the output already has a ukui_background_v1 object with the same type, the ukui_background_exists protocol error will be raised.

interface.name: ukui_background_v1
interface.description: This interface represents a background object with a buffer.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the object. The clients using this object automatically updated on the next frame.

request.name: set_buffer

description.summary: set background data from a pixel buffer

request.description:
This request sets pixel data supplied as wl_buffer to the background.
The wl_buffer supplying pixel data as 'buffer' should be equal to the logical size of the output or its proportional scaling. If the output is rotated, the pixel data in the buffer should be rotated.
If this background instance already has a buffer from a previous 'set_buffer' request, data from the last request overrides the preexisting pixel data.
The wl_buffer must be kept alive for as long as the ukui_background_v1 it is associated with is not destroyed, otherwise treat it as no background. The wl_buffer.release event is unused.

event.name: failed
event.description: Emitted when the output is removed, or if the background object was created with an invalid type or an invalid output. When this happens, the background objects become inert, and should be destroyed.
